title: WPSS/6/2024 of GOVIND SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No.06 of 2024
Govind Singh ........Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & another ........Respondent
Presence:-
Mr. D.S. Mehta, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Sushil Vashistha, learned Standing Counsel for the State.
Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for the respondent no.2-
Commission.

By means of this writ petition, petitioner has
sought the indulgence of this Court for a direction for
quashing the order dated 19.12.2023 issued by the
respondent no.2-Commission, whereby the petitioner was
directed to supply the evidence of possessing
intermediate qualification, otherwise the candidature of
the petitioner would be rejected.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3. It is the case of the petitioner that petitioner is
a Ex-Army Personnel, who retired from the Indian Army
after putting more than seventeen years of service.
Pursuant to the advertisement dated 21.10.2022,
petitioner submitted his candidature for the post of
Forest Guard under the quota reserved for Ex-Army
Personnel in the Uttarakhand. According to the
advertisement, the educational qualification for the said
post is intermediate or equivalent qualification. Petitioner
being a retired Ex-Army Man and having a graduate
certificate submitted his candidature, but instead of
considering the candidature of the petitioner, the
petitioner was called upon to supply some evidence
regarding the fact that he possessed the qualification of
intermediate.

2
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the
petitioner that as per the graduation certificate, which is
annexed as annexre-2 to the writ petition, petitioner is a
graduate and has passed the matriculation examination
in the year 2000 from G.I.C. Shantipuri, U.S. Nagar,
there is no point in calling upon the petitioner to give
proof of his intermediate qualification. He further drawn
the attention of this Court at page 46 of the writ petition
and submits that there is a Government Order issued by
the State of Uttarakhand, wherein a certificate of
graduate, which is annexed and supplied by the
petitioner is to be considered for Group-C services being
educationally eligible for the said post.
5. From perusal of the record as well as the
impugned order dated 19.12.2023, it is not clear as to
whether as yet the candidature of the petitioner has been
rejected or not.
6. In this view of the matter, the writ petition is
disposed-off finally with a direction to the petitioner to
move a representation detailing his grievances therein to
the Secretary of the respondent-Commission within a
period of three days' from today and the respondent-Secretary of the Commission shall decide the same, in
accordance with law with a speaking and reasoned order,
within one week thereafter.
7. Let a certified copy of this order be issued to
the learned counsel for the parties, today itself, on
payment of usual charges.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 04.01.2024
AK
